question: Will OpenAI release a new flagship GPT model before January 1, 2027?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if OpenAI publicly released a new flagship GPT model (i.e., a model explicitly designated by OpenAI as its flagship or lead model in a new GPT generation or sub-generation) on or before December 31, 2026, UTC.
- "No": Wins if no such flagship GPT model release occurred on or before December 31, 2026, UTC.

Clarifications:
- A qualifying release requires a public general-availability announcement from OpenAI (not a limited preview, waitlist, or partner-only access). The model must be identified by OpenAI itself as a flagship, lead, or primary model of a new GPT generation or sub-generation (e.g., GPT-X or GPT-X.Y), distinct from previously released flagship models.
